triggered_escalators.rationale: Chronic intracortical implantation, percutaneous interfaces and clinically burdensome removal.
The system performs digital output actuation but does not stimulate or physiologically actuate the participant.
Language-model reconstruction converts neural speech features into word sequences and requires signal-versus-prior controls.
Severe disability, care dependence and actual workplace use create power, vulnerability and sectoral safeguards.
Restricted neural, transcript, gaze, usage and model-training data are logged and reused.
Communication and computer access depend on specialist staff, care partners, proprietary hardware and evolving research software.
Intracortical decoding has foreseeable surveillance, coercive and defence misuse potential.
Public narratives can collapse participant-specific research, researcher-free operation, trial safety and product readiness.

profile_selection.selection_rationale: Implantation, direct neural data, generative text reconstruction, essential communication dependence, home operation, iterative changes and uncertain post-trial continuity require AP-3 and CL-4. Public evidence supports a bounded participant-specific scientific claim but not CL-4 conformance.
unresolved_profile_questions: Whether the current post-publication system introduces additional devices, cloud services, models, connected platforms or employment-related data flows.

legacy_bounded_decision.strongest_supported_claim: Within the ongoing BrainGate2 IDE and for participant T15 only, a changing four-array percutaneous intracortical research system supported long-term multimodal communication and computer access at home. After an IDE amendment and trained care-partner setup, T15 used it without research-team presence for 3,801 hours across 444 of 653 days. Prompted copy-task speech decoding reached 99.2% vocalized and 96.5% silent word accuracy, and structured cursor control reached 2.90 bits per second. Naturalistic communication was high-volume but participant-rated, correction-dependent and materially dependent on continuous recalibration, iterative software and model changes, a language-model prior, gaze control, care partners, a bulky networked cart and ongoing research infrastructure. The evidence does not establish trial-wide safety, population effectiveness, fully implanted portability, product readiness or complete CL-4 conformance.
